request.summary: Root .claude-plugin/marketplace.json lists plugin toolkit (./plugins/toolkit, plugin.json without version so commits are releases). create-coordinator SKILL.md, launch.ps1 and resolve-projects.ps1 are copied byte for byte from release 0.2.0 (SHA-256 pinned, BOM kept, .gitattributes eol=lf). README covers install, update, rollback and development; AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md give repository rules. tests/toolkit.test.mjs (white-box) and tests/blackbox.test.mjs (written independently from the spec) verify manifests, containment, hashes, BOMs, developer-only invocation, no version and the exact skill set. claude plugin validate passes on the marketplace and lists toolkit:create-coordinator. UX/UI: no rendered interface; the only user-visible change is the skill name /toolkit:create-coordinator, documented in the README.
